en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play dodgeball
Let's burn this place to the ground
You want to spar with me?
I like dodgeball!

It's a good way to release all my pent-up
hatred toward the degenerates!
So, let's start!
I don't understand you one bit, Shuichi.
But...

Now I completely understand that
males are worthless after all!

Degenerate males should be the ones
burning, not the gym!

Sure!
I'll be your sparring partner!

It might be too dangerous to throw you
on the floor here, though...

Well, I guess I'll have to throw you
lightly enough so that I don't kill you.

Of course, *just* enough so you
don't die!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tenko's inner thoughts...?
